messages:
michelle: Quick sync — need to finalize launch gating for the console observability work: dashboards (customer templates), tracing hooks (server+client), cost breakdown (per-model/day + drilldowns), and error analytics (rollups + alerting). What should be in MVP vs phase 2?

ajay: I'd push dashboards + tracing hooks into MVP. Cost drilldowns and advanced error analytics can be deferred. Enterprise customers (AcmeCorp, NovaHealth) repeatedly asked for traces + quick dashboards to validate incidents.

sofia: +1. Acceptance criteria suggestion:
- dashboards: 3 baseline tiles (p50/p95 latency, error rate, cost) + filter by model and route
- tracing hooks: distributed trace headers, sampling config, and mapping trace_id -> request_id in logs
- error analytics (MVP): aggregated error counts by code + top 5 sample payloads

dave: Resource callout: eng-ml + eng-platform realistically have 2 sprints before the SG launch. If we aim for full cost-per-route in MVP it will slip. Proposal: MVP cost = daily aggregate per model + cost trend sparkline. Phase 2 = per-route and token-level.

michelle: That aligns with what I was thinking. Proposed launch gates (must-have for MVP):
1) Dashboards with the 3 core tiles and model/route filters operational in staging
2) Tracing hooks instrumented end-to-end and validated on staging (trace sampling configurable)
3) Basic cost summary per model (daily) ingest + display
4) An automated smoke test that runs a few representative requests and verifies metrics emission
Anything else is a stretch for MVP and moves to Phase 2.

ajay: Canary plan: roll to 10% of traffic on dedicated hosts, monitor for 48h. Promotion criteria: tracing coverage >= 80%, dashboard refresh latency < 60s, no spike in error-rate or tail latency. If any criterion fails, auto-rollback.

sofia: We also need docs + runbook before canary. I'll own the acceptance criteria doc and runbook. Quick smoke test stub below:
```
# smoke test (staging)
curl -H "x-request-id: $R" "https://staging.console/api/v1/infer?model=redwood-small&route=chat"
# expect metrics: observability.request.latency, observability.request.error, observability.request.cost
```

dave: Owners: sofia -> acceptance + runbook, ajay -> tracing infra + rollout automation, dave -> cost estimation and ingestion path, michelle -> overall rollout owner and customer comms. Timeline: spec PR today, 2-sprint delivery window, canary in sprint 3.

deploy-bot: CI · console-observability · branch=feature/console-obsv · build #342 · tests=128/128 · status=passed

michelle: Great. I'll open a short spec PR now and tag owners (CC @sofia @ajay @dave). Action items:
- michelle: PR + customer notes (today)
- sofia: detailed acceptance criteria + runbook (EOD + link in PR)
- ajay: tracing rollout plan + canary automation checklist (2 days)
- dave: cost ingest plan + narrow MVP scoping for token cost (3 days)

michelle: Thanks everyone :rocket:
